notes: 'Donald W. Reynolds Razorback Stadium will become CommunityAmerica Razorback Stadium beginning with the 2027 football season.' The stadium keeps the Donald W. Reynolds name for the 2026 season; WholeHogSports: 'the name of the stadium won't officially change until 2027.' Talk Business (Jun 24 2026) gives the date as 'on July 1, 2027.'

'Arkansas Athletics, CommunityAmerica Credit Union launch multi-year partnership including Razorback Stadium naming rights' (release headline). Deal was 'Facilitated by Learfield and Razorback Sports Properties'; CommunityAmerica also becomes the Official Credit Union of Arkansas Athletics.

'CommunityAmerica Credit Union is a not-for-profit financial institution' - the release also calls it 'the largest credit union in Arkansas, Kansas, and Missouri'. Talk Business describes it as 'Lenexa, Kan.-based CommunityAmerica Credit Union'.

'The Razorback Stadium naming rights contract between CommunityAmerica Credit Union and Learfield is for 14 years' - a paid corporate naming-rights contract (the word 'commercial' is the workbook's category, not the article's). It replaces the Reynolds name; Talk Business: 'The Donald W. Reynolds Foundation paid $20 million in 1999 for 25-year naming rights to the stadium.'

'On July 1, 2027, the naming rights portion of the deal will go into effect.' This is the year the name goes on the stadium. The sponsorship contract itself starts a year earlier: WholeHogSports (Jun 30 2026) says it 'goes into effect Wednesday and runs through June 30, 2040', with the name added 'in the second year of the agreement.'

'Contract details showed the CommunityAmerica deal was for 14 years, with 13 to include the credit union's name on the stadium.' 13 is the stated number of years the name is on the stadium (pairs with the 2027 start); the overall contract is 14 years, obtained by the paper 'through a Freedom of Information Act request'. The AD first said 13 years and Talk Business reported '13-year'; the official release gives no number ('a long-term partnership').

'annual rights value of between $5 million and $5.4 million' - a range, so not recorded. The paper's earlier story says 'for an average of about $5.4 million annually' (sourced, not official). The school did not disclose terms; 15 of the contract's 22 pages are redacted.

'The agreement is worth a total of $70 million over 14 years, WholeHogSports has learned, for an average of about $5.4 million annually.' Sourced newspaper report, not an official figure: the release gives no value and Talk Business says 'Financial terms were not disclosed.' The paper's Jun 30 story adds it is 'unclear whether that figure is the value of the 14-year agreement' or only the 13 naming years.

'The indoor arena will now be named the Tower Hill Arena' - approved by UF trustees Nov 10 2026. Official release title (Nov 11 2026): 'Tower Hill Insurance Makes Significant Investment in Gator Athletics with Naming Rights to Tower Hill Arena'. The building keeps its name (Gainesville Sun: 'The Stephen C. O'Connell Center itself will retain its name.'); no page read states a longer styled form such as '... at the Stephen C. O'Connell Center'.

'Tower Hill Insurance Makes Significant Investment in Gator Athletics with Naming Rights to Tower Hill Arena' (official release title; only the title of this page rendered). The Gainesville Sun and WCJB name the counterparty as 'Tower Hill Insurance Group'. Exactech's deal has ended - Gainesville Sun: 'UF spokesperson Steve Orlando said the Exactech contract expired over the summer,'.

'UAA and Tower Hill Insurance Group have agreed to an initial five-year deal running from July 1, 2026,' - industry taken from the company name as stated. The Independent Florida Alligator (Nov 11 2026): 'Tower Hill was founded in 1972 as a small South Florida insurance agency'.

'approved a naming deal with Tower Hill Insurance Group on Tuesday.' - a corporate naming-rights deal (the word 'commercial' is the workbook's category, not the article's). It replaces the Exactech name the arena carried 'since 2016'; WCJB: 'Exactech's contract for the arena expired this summer.'

'UAA and Tower Hill Insurance Group have agreed to an initial five-year deal running from July 1, 2026, through June 30, 2031, with an option to extend the agreement for another five years through June 2036.'

'UAA and Tower Hill Insurance Group have agreed to an initial five-year deal running from July 1, 2026, through June 30, 2031, with an option to extend the agreement for another five years through June 2036.' Initial term only; the five-year extension is an option.

'do not disclose how much Tower Hill will pay for the naming rights.' No annual figure is stated on any page read; the terms are in a memorandum of understanding and the board materials give no amount.

'do not disclose how much Tower Hill will pay for the naming rights.' Not disclosed. The student paper (Independent Florida Alligator, Nov 11 2026) says the deal is 'reportedly valued at $22.5 million' with no attribution; a repost of other coverage ties $22.5 million to a separate loan approved at the same meeting, so the figure is not recorded.
